import hashlib, json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
import execution_spec as E
from execute_provider import provider_contract
from observe_output import observe, no_turn
assert E.CURRENT_PROVIDER_CONTRACT == 8 and 8 in E.PROVIDER_CONTRACTS_V3, "contract 8"
assert "[2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8]" in open("schemas/execution-spec.schema.json").read(), "schema enum"
def spec(model, effort, contract):
    return {"provider": "agy", "model": model, "effort": effort, "speed": "unknown", "repo": "/r", "prompt": "P",
            "write_scope": [], "role": "worker", "provider_contract_version": contract}
for e in ("low", "medium", "high"):
    argv, env = provider_contract(spec("gemini-3.8-flash-" + e, e, 8))
    assert argv == ["agy", "--dangerously-skip-permissions", "--print-timeout", "30m", "--model", "gemini-3.8-flash-" + e,
                    "--output-format", "stream-json", "-p", "P"], argv
for model, effort, msg in (("gemini-3.8-flash-high", "medium", "agy model name encodes effort high; spec effort is medium"),
                           ("test-model", "medium", "agy model name must end in an effort token (-low, -medium or -high)")):
    try:
        provider_contract(spec(model, effort, 8))
    except E.SpecError as exc:
        assert str(exc) == msg, str(exc)
    else:
        raise AssertionError("not refused: " + model)
assert provider_contract(spec("test-model", "medium", 7))[0] == ["agy", "--dangerously-skip-permissions", "--print-timeout", "30m",
    "--model", "test-model", "--effort", "medium", "-p", "P"], "contract 7 changed"
raw = open("tests/fixtures/observe/agy.jsonl", "rb").read()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == "34d75747ec72ae274bd462e50cbf59952b0b39e39223d12aa623f85e9cb829f6", "fixture bytes"
o = observe("agy", raw)
assert o["observed_model"] == {"value": "gemini-3.8-flash-low", "source": "observed"}, o
assert {k: v["value"] for k, v in o["usage"].items()} == {"input": 15015, "output": 1, "cache": 0, "reasoning": 0}, o
assert no_turn("agy", raw) is False
lines = raw.decode().splitlines()
hang = json.loads(lines[4]); hang["result"].update(response="", num_turns=0)
assert no_turn("agy", ("\n".join(lines[:4] + [json.dumps(hang)]) + "\n").encode()) is True, "num_turns 0"
assert no_turn("agy", ("\n".join(lines[:3]) + "\n").encode()) is True, "no result"
print("ok")
